items.source: At least one class must be specified either via value() or classes.
items.translation: 必须通过value()或classes指定至少一个类。

items.source:
For each class hints are registered for constructors, fields, properties,
and record components. Hints are also registered for types transitively used
on properties and record components.
items.translation: 每个类都会为构造函数、字段、属性和记录组件注册提示。此外，还会为在属性和记录组件上透传使用的类型注册提示。

items.source:
When the annotated element is a type, the type itself is registered if no
candidates are provided:
items.translation: 当注解的元素是一个类型时，如果没有提供候选者，则该类型本身会被注册：

items.source: Alternative to classes() to specify the classes as class names.
items.translation: 作为classes()的替代方案，可将类指定为类名。

items.source: If scanning of Reflective is enabled, any type in the configured packages can use this annotation as well.
items.translation: 如果启用了 `Reflective` 的扫描，则配置的任何包中的类型也可以使用此注解。

items.source: The annotated element can also be any test class that uses the Spring TestContext Framework to load an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 注释的元素也可以是任何使用Spring TestContext 框架加载ApplicationContext的测试类。

items.source: You can use this annotation on any bean that is contributed to the context:
items.translation: 您可以在贡献到上下文的任何 Bean 上使用此注解：

items.source: Classes for which reflection hints should be registered.
